seo.title: Vehicle-specific tuning advice
seo.checksTitle: What do we check before tuning?
seo.checksText: For a safe calibration we check ECU type, engine variant, fault codes, maintenance condition, transmission and available log data. This keeps the tune matched to the real condition of the car.
seo.vehicleSpecificText: Power and torque vary by model year, software version, fuel quality, mileage and hardware. NoordTune therefore treats the catalog as an indication and confirms exact possibilities per vehicle.
seo.stageChoiceText: Stage 1 is intended for original hardware and reliable daily use. Stage 2 only makes sense when supporting hardware and maintenance condition are suitable for extra load.
seo.quoteText: Send your selection via WhatsApp or ask for advice. We check the selected stage, options and vehicle data before confirming a final quote.

VehicleCheck.metaTitle: Free vehicle check with tuning advice | NoordTune Assen
VehicleCheck.metaDescription: Check APK, odometer judgement, recalls, vehicle details and tuning potential using official RDW data.
VehicleCheck.title: Vehicle check before you buy
VehicleCheck.intro: Review important official vehicle information before you decide. See RDW attention points, recent APK defects, recalls and then the car's tuning potential.
VehicleCheck.privacy: Your plate is used only for the current RDW check and is not stored in a customer profile or public results page.
VehicleCheck.shownTitle: What does this vehicle check show?
VehicleCheck.shownIntro: The check combines useful official information without presenting itself as a complete vehicle-history report.
VehicleCheck.shown1Text: First admission, registration, APK date, transfer status and relevant official indicators.
VehicleCheck.shown2Text: The official RDW odometer judgement and current open-recall status where available.
VehicleCheck.shown3Text: A bounded view of recently reported APK defects with official defect codes and descriptions.
VehicleCheck.checklistIntro: Use RDW data as a first check and combine it with documents and a physical inspection.
VehicleCheck.checklist1: Compare the plate, VIN and vehicle documents.
VehicleCheck.checklist2: Review maintenance invoices and compare them with the current odometer.
VehicleCheck.checklist3: Confirm open recalls with the manufacturer or dealer.
VehicleCheck.checklist4: Have fault codes, live data, leaks, wear and the test drive professionally assessed.
VehicleCheck.tuningTitle: Explore the tuning potential as well
VehicleCheck.tuningText: After the vehicle check, the NoordTune catalog shows a vehicle-specific tuning estimate. The final engine, ECU and TCU configuration is confirmed before tuning.
VehicleCheck.inspectionText: RDW data does not show current fault codes, live data, wear or mechanical condition. NoordTune can perform a technical pre-purchase inspection and diagnostic scan.
VehicleCheck.faq1Question: Is this a complete damage or ownership report?
VehicleCheck.faq1Answer: No. The check uses official RDW Open Data, but it does not provide complete damage history, owner identity or a full ownership history.
VehicleCheck.faq2Question: Can I see individual odometer readings?
VehicleCheck.faq2Answer: No. We show only the official odometer judgement and last registration year when supplied by RDW, not the individual readings.
VehicleCheck.faq3Question: Does no warning mean the car is mechanically sound?
VehicleCheck.faq3Answer: No. An RDW check cannot reveal current fault codes, wear, leaks or mechanical condition. A physical inspection and diagnostic scan remain recommended.
VehicleCheck.faq4Answer: NoordTune creates no public plate page and does not store the plate in localStorage or analytics. The server uses a hashed temporary cache to reduce load on the official source.
